# MEMRYA

> MEMRYA is an iPhone-first AI conversation memory product. Users record or import audio, which is uploaded/assembled, transcribed, and analyzed into a Summary, Evidence, and Ask view, with export/share options.

## Current state

MEMRYA is in private development, preparing its first paid release. The public website repo is intentionally separate from the private app repo.

## Product

- Core flow: record/import audio -> upload/assemble -> transcription -> analysis -> Summary/Evidence/Ask -> export/share.
- Existing audio import is a core use case.
- Speaker diarization and contextual/name speaker identity exist today.
- Cross-recording biometric Voice Identity is a P0 launch requirement, designed for explicit enrollment and local/on-device profile storage; it is still in validation and not marketed as generally available. Weak or ambiguous matches are surfaced only as suggestions, never guesses.
- Not all long-form/reliability gates are finished yet.

## Languages

- Public UI languages: English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian. Arabic renders true RTL.
- The processing provider catalogue covers a broader set of languages than the UI, and transcription quality is not claimed to be equal across every provider-supported language.
- Spoken Language and Result Language are separate settings; Result Language defaults to Same as conversation.

## Integrations

- Zoom cloud-recording import architecture exists but is not publicly enabled.
- Google Meet integration is planned after Zoom; Microsoft Teams later. These are not presented as live integrations today.

## Billing

- Recording on device is intended to remain free.
- Cloud processing consumes processing minutes.
- Final App Store/RevenueCat prices are not yet public; no prices should be assumed.

## Trust and privacy

- Provider/API secrets are server-side only, never embedded in the mobile client.
- Cloud storage is private with owner-scoped access; tenant isolation is a product invariant.
- Processed audio/transcripts may be sent securely to approved processing providers after the user chooses processing.
- Final retention/legal policy is still being completed before public launch.
- MEMRYA does not claim end-to-end encryption.
- Account export/delete functions exist server-side, but public-launch QA for them is still open.

## Website

- Domain: https://memrya.co
- No analytics, cookies, third-party JavaScript, trackers, or public API keys. Strict CSP.
